system.description: After identifying which ritual currently afflicts you, you acquire a component used in its casting and destroy it, subtracting your successes from those of the original caster. Wipe away all of the original successes and the ritual ends immediately, along with whatever consequences accompany its ending — a fact worth considering before unweaving something like a Blood Contract. Only rituals with an ongoing duration can be unwoven, and only from yourself.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
